title.rendered: Paradise Ballroom Fremont Wedding Disc Jockey

content.rendered:
Set Up at Paradise Ballroom for Gypsy Wedding.
I have played here many times for Arabic Weddings, Indian Parties & Quinceanera.

Uplighting provided by California Disc Jockey Entertainment & Other Lighting Effects.

Patron on ice anyone?. This one is Patron in ice Scupture :).

There were performers like Flamenco, Tango dancers, Spanish guitarist.

I like playing at Gypsy Weddings, They have great music style,
This time we played 80s 90s, freestyle, spanish, french, electronic, gypsy music and guitarist was awesome.

DJ Chris Webb

We Provide Led Uplighting for Weddings and Special Events like this one.
